card.title: Salary or wages not paid
card.forum: Labour Department of your district (Inspector-cum-Facilitator / Labour Commissioner)
steps: Write to the employer by email or WhatsApp asking for the exact unpaid amount by a date. Keep the reply, or the silence, as proof.
Send a legal notice demanding payment within 15 days. सहाय can draft it below.
File a wage claim with the Labour Department of your district. Many states accept it online, and the Shram Suvidha or Samadhan portals cover central-sphere establishments.
If the employer still does not pay, a civil suit for recovery of money is possible. Ask the DLSA for a free lawyer first.
documents: Salary slips or bank statements showing past credits
Messages with the employer about the payment
card.deadline: Act quickly. Wage claims have a time limit under the Code on Wages, 2019, and money recovery suits generally have three years under the Limitation Act. Verify your exact deadline with the DLSA.
card.cost: A Labour Department complaint is usually free. You do not need a lawyer to file it.

legal_aid.title: Free lawyer from the District Legal Services Authority (DLSA)
legal_aid.body: Every district has a DLSA that gives a free lawyer to eligible people under Section 12 of the Legal Services Authorities Act, 1987: women and children, SC/ST members, industrial workmen, people in custody, persons with disabilities, victims of disaster or trafficking, and people below the state's income limit. Call 15100 or visit the DLSA office at your district court.
